title: FAA UAP reports, batch 23 (237UAP00614 - 237UAP00638)
doc_notes: This document is a batch of FAA UAP reports containing two close-approach encounters and several distant sightings.

encounters.summary: United 1986 reported a black UFO 100 feet from their 1 o'clock position while at 8,000 feet.
encounters.quote: REPORTED A BLACK UFO 100 FEET FROM THEIR 1 O'CLOCK POSITION

encounters.summary: Public use TROY21 reported a football-sized, cylindrical UAP traveling 10 feet below their right wing at FL200.
encounters.quote: REPORTED AN UNIDENTIFIED AERIAL PHENOMENON TRAVEL 10 FEET BELOW RIGHT WING
